title: MHA Launches 'VINIMAY' Land Port Management System for 15 Operational Land Ports
summary: Digitises 90% paperwork using Single Electronic Window and ANPR gate systems.

blocks.content: Digitises 90% paperwork using Single Electronic Window and ANPR gate systems.

items: VINIMAY Platform: Integrated digital platform launched by Amit Shah under MHA's 'Smart Borders' strategy.
Efficiency Gain: Cuts truck waiting times by 40-60% and gate processing by 22-35%.
Trade Growth: Land port trade surged 16-fold from ₹5,000 crore in 2014 to ₹83,000 crore in 2026.
